title: Localize Skill lifecycle labels in Vietnamese
context: SkillsScreen renders the Discover, Scope, Validate, Execute and Verify headings through LocalizedStringKey, but the English and Vietnamese localization catalogs have no entries for these labels.
goal: Make all five Skill lifecycle headings resolve through the selected app language, with natural Vietnamese translations and unchanged runtime behavior.
forbidden_changes: Do not change Skill discovery, selection, authorization or execution behavior.
Do not rename the localization keys used by SkillsScreen.
Do not translate product identifiers or manifest IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Both localization catalogs define Discover, Scope, Validate, Execute and Verify.
Vietnamese translations are Khám phá, Phạm vi, Kiểm tra điều kiện, Thực thi and Xác minh.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Check all five keys exist in both localization catalogs
recovery: Revert the single task commit if localization lookup or Apple build regresses.
